g.text: NUDGE • PHASE 2
One native app, five places
Proposed adaptation map · source-derived parity, not an app screenshot
Today → About you → Decide
Answer a question, inspect the supporting
answer, then use relevant evidence in a
comparison.
Tools + Account
Earlier learning, circles and outcome
patterns stay available. Privacy, export and
deletion remain easy to find.
Local draft ≠ saved answer
Keep drafts through poor networks; confirm
account writes only after the server. Never
silently replay a stale privacy generation.
Permissions after a reason
Share on request. No first-launch permission
wall. Native push is a separate integration
and device-verification gate.
Design specification • Proposals and verification boundaries • Not an app screenshot
